_README: Schema for narrative/{DATE}.json — the written half of the report. Copy this file to
narrative/YYYY-MM-DD.json and fill it in against data/news_{DATE}.json.
- Never restate a number the tables already carry unless the sentence needs it to
make a point. Every figure quoted here must match data/agg_{DATE}.json.
- A mover with no in-window evidence gets labelled beta. Do not invent a catalyst.
<span class="c-neg">. Everything else is stripped by the Markdown export.
- s4 should cover the largest movers with independent catalysts plus the reverse
representatives — roughly 25-30 entries. Order is the order they render.
- s4[].ticker must exist in the universe or the Korea anchors; price, pct and
dollar volume are looked up automatically, so never type them into the heading.
- s4[].tag is optional: use it for '韩国锚', 'beta 备注', '反向备注'.
- s3_notes keys must match universe.SECTORS names exactly. s3_chains is optional
and renders as a bullet list under the sector note.
